import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    a0 = p[0] + p[1]/t
    b = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*t**2
    K = p[5] + p[6]*t
    d = p[7] + p[8]*t
    L = p[9]
    return a0 + b*A/(K + A) + d*A*np.exp(-L*A)
